product_summary: Anuh Pharma Ltd (Mumbai, Maharashtra; NSE: ANUHPHR, BSE: 506260; part of SK Group) is an Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturer since 1960, with plants at Tarapur (Units E-17, E-18, F-10) and Turbhe (Unit D-5, corticosteroids). Per its own website (anuhpharma.com, homepage, accessed for this check) the portfolio is organised in seven lines: (1) Macrolides — erythromycin salts, azithromycin; (2) Anti-TB — pyrazinamide, isoniazid and intermediates; (3) Anti-malarials — sulfadoxine, pyrimethamine, amodiaquine; (4) Anti-bacterials — sulfa and allied actives; (5) Anti-diabetics — gliclazide, vildagliptin, dapagliflozin; (6) Corticosteroids — specialised steroid APIs; (7) CDMO services (custom development / contract manufacturing). Stated capacity 2,975 MTPA multi-purpose; claims USFDA, EDQM/EU-GMP (AEMPS), WHO-PQ and CEPs. The detailed product catalogue page could not be opened (all /products/* URLs returned HTTP 404), so the molecule list above is taken from the homepage category descriptions only — individual grade-level product pages were not verified.
comment: HS mapping: declared codes 292219, 292429, 293349, 293359 are only partially consistent with the actual portfolio. The declared set is dominated by non-antibiotic heterocyclic/amide intermediates, while the company's flagship lines are antibiotics (erythromycin salts, azithromycin) which belong to heading 2941 (294150 / 29419090) and are entirely absent from the declaration — a significant product line missing from the declared HS. Corticosteroid APIs (Turbhe Unit D-5) map to heading 2937 (293722/293729), also absent from the declaration. Conversely, 293349 (heterocyclic compounds containing a quinoline/isoquinoline ring) has no corroboration in the published portfolio — amodiaquine is a quinoline-type antimalarial and could justify it, but this is not stated on the site, so it is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. 293359 (pyrimidine-ring heterocyclics) is plausible for pyrimethamine/sulfadoxine-type actives — partial corroboration. 292429 (other amides) is plausible for pyrazinamide/intermediates — partial. 292219 (amino-alcohols/amino compounds) is plausible only for intermediates — not corroborated. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: this is a pharmaceutical API / fine-chemical manufacturer, not oil & gas. Trader signs: none — the company presents itself as an integrated manufacturer with own reactors and cGMP plants, so role = manufacturer; no evidence of pure trading activity. All product claims above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope). Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a ground for rejection: the company is retained and the code set should be corrected to include 2941 (macrolide/other antibiotics) and 2937 (corticosteroids) alongside the existing heterocyclic codes.
